tokens.v: His hand brings the amber bottle toward the lens mid-reach, the gold pipette already lifted in his other hand with one drop necked off and falling, caught mid-air between dropper tip and the back of his wrist. 50mm at f/2.2 at chest height, warm side-window light: the bottle and the falling drop sharp, his groomed beard and easy smile softening one plane back, the short dark curls holding the top edge. A pushed-up waffle-knit sleeve in warm grey blurs across the bottom-left corner, cut by it. AURELIA reads letterpress-debossed across the cream band, large and clean, shadow pooling in the impression.
